agent.gather_sql:
SELECT CASE 
    WHEN mtime >= 1791763200 - 86400 * 30 THEN '0-30 days'
    WHEN mtime >= 1791763200 - 86400 * 60 THEN '31-60 days'
    WHEN mtime >= 1791763200 - 86400 * 90 THEN '61-90 days'
    ELSE 'More than 90 days'
END AS age_group, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(size) AS total_size 
FROM intermediate 
GROUP BY age_group
agent.gather_shape: age_group TEXT, count INT64, total_size INT64
agent.final_sql: SELECT age_group, SUM(count) AS total_files, SUM(total_size) AS total_size FROM aggregate GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY total_files DESC
